description: Render a preview PNG of the artwork on the product in the chosen colour and placement. style flat draws the placement; style packshot uses a product photo with the exact print at real size, or gives the flat preview with a note when no photo exists. Returns mockup_url, blank_image_url and image_prompt (an optional text prompt for an illustration of a person who wears the product; such an image is an illustration, not the exact print). Optional.

left_mm.description: Distance from the left edge of the print area. Default: horizontally centred.

placement.description: Print location on the product, e.g. "front" or "back". See get_product for the list.

preset.description: Named position inside the placement, e.g. "center_chest", "left_chest", "full_front". Defaults to the placement default.

style.description: flat: quick placement drawing. packshot: product photo with the exact print at real size (where a product photo exists).

top_mm.description: Distance from the top of the print area to the top of the artwork.

width_mm.description: Exact printed width of the visible artwork in millimetres. Height follows the aspect ratio.

name: create_mockup

image_prompt.description: A prompt for your own image model, to make an illustration from mockup_url.

mockup_url.description: PNG preview of the exact print on the product.

title: Create a preview mockup
